## Portraius Studio: Kling one-take

The Director's one-take: Kling 3.0 Omni shoots the whole scene as one clip, one storyboard per shot, from the Tour's sample scene "The Letter, again". Each shot's prompt names its references with Kling's `<<<image_n>>>` tokens, then adds the location and camera while it fits in 512 characters, as the app does.

Put a character's sheet and front view in `ComfyUI/input/` as `walt-sheet.jpg` and `walt-front.jpg`: unzip any `.portraius` file, they're `sheet/turnaround.png` and `sheet/front.png`. The samples are in this repo's `public/samples/`.

The app sends the references as separate images. ComfyUI's node takes one batch, and Batch Images makes every image the first one's size, so the front view is padded to the sheet's shape first rather than cropped. The storyboards' lengths must add up to the node's duration (15 s at most). 720p is the app's setting (Kling's "std"). Needs a Comfy account with credits: these are partner nodes.
